title: MLflow tracking URI points at a public host
explanation: MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI is an http(s) URL on a public host, so runs, parameters, metrics and artifacts that MLflow logs are sent to that server. With no URI MLflow writes to a local file store. A "databricks" URI (the hosted Databricks service) is not detected by this rule.

evidence.detail: image env MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI points at public host mlflow.vendor.example.com

fix: Point MLFLOW_TRACKING_URI at a tracking server inside the enclave, or at a local path (file:///...), or unset it.
